scripts.check: bun run --cwd apps/web check && bunx biome check --write --config-path apps/web/biome.json packages package.json
scripts.test: bun test --cwd apps/web && bun test packages
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/session-client/tsconfig.json
